newsitem.title: USA: NYS unemployment at 6.2 pct in May, unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NYS unemployment at 6.2 pct in May, unchanged.

text.p: New York State's unemployment rate was 6.2 percent in May, unchanged from April, the State Labor Department said on Tuesday.
The department in a statement said that the number of jobs in New York State exceeded 8 million in May for the first time in seven years.
New York City's unemployment rate was 9.4 percent for May, down from 9.7 percent the month before.
New York's job count increased 74,600 from April to May, or about 5,800 more than the average for that time of the year.
"Employment advanced in every industry in May," said Thomas A. Rodick, director of the Division of Research and Statistics.
In May 1997, New York had 8,033,400 total nonfarm jobs, including 6,636,700 private sector jobs. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
